_comment: GOLDEN wire-shape snapshot of the auditloop plugin-push `metadata` body that this harness emits. It exists to make DRIFT between the harness's hand-mirrored structs (e2e/uxaudit/push.go: PushPayload/PushPage/PushFinding) and auditloop's REAL schema fail a TEST, not a live push. The json KEYS below must match auditloop's server field names exactly (viewport values mobile|desktop; finding.type in a11y|console|network|perf|layout|other). Mirrored from auditloop internal/plugin/schema.go @ commit 0da3004 (2026-07-24). auditloop's PushPage additionally accepts OPTIONAL `perf` and `layout` measurement blocks (omitempty); this harness deliberately does NOT emit them, so they are absent here by design. When you re-mirror, bump this comment's commit/date and update push.go together.
